newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Britain's Prince Andrew meets Zimbabwe's Mugabe.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Andrew meets Zimbabwe's Mugabe.

text.p: Britain's Prince Andrew paid a courtesy call on Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe on Wednesday on the second of a three-day official visit during he will witness a landmark joint military exercise by eight southern African countries.
The prince went to Mugabe's official Zimbabwe State House and was hosted by the Zimbabwean leader and his wife, Grace, for nearly an hour.
Prince Andrew and Mugabe are due to witness on Thursday a regional military exercise partly funded by Britain and being staged Zimbabwe's eastern Nyanga district.

Some 1,100 troops from Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, Swaziland, Tanzania and Zimbabwe -- all Commonwealth members -- are taking part in the exercise, the first of its kind in Africa aimed at improving peacekeeping skills.
